approvalPendingDesc: Your account is pending approval by your region lead. Some features may be limited.
emergencySosDesc: Alerts operator with your account, booking, reason and location.
keepJobsClean: Keep jobs clean, avoid late cancellations, and protect every job with completion photos.
duesWarning: Dues above Rs.100 limit access to one job per day and can reduce GigScore until cleared.
walletHealthy: Wallet is healthy. Cash-collected bookings stay tracked here.
recoveryNote: Recovery: pay dues, complete clean jobs, keep confirmation photos ready.
payoutHoldNote: Paid completed work can be withdrawn after the hold period when no dispute is open.
bankAccountNote: Bank account is managed from My Profile.
alertsEnabled: Enabled on this browser. Gigtos can alert you even when the app is in the background.
alertsWaiting: Waiting for web push key setup. Job offers still appear here in real time.
alertsBlocked: Notifications are blocked in this browser. Offers still appear here while the app is open.
alertsPrompt: Enable browser alerts so you do not miss short job offers.
noOpenServices: No open services around you right now
